title: ProposeLineEditTool
description: Propose a line range edit protected by Compare-And-Swap (CAS) hash validation.

start_line.description: 1-indexed starting line number of the target block.

end_line.description: 1-indexed inclusive ending line number of the target block.

new_content.description: New replacement content for the specified line range.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the target file content obtained from read_file.

patch_id.description: Unique identifier for the staged patch proposal.

diff_preview.description: Server-generated unified diff preview showing proposed changes.
